en: Black-and-white postcard showing a decorative fountain with carved human figures around its central drum, spraying water into a circular basin adorned with floral motifs. Behind the fountain stand the stone ruins of an old building or fortification, surrounded by trees and a park-like setting. The reverse side has Hungarian text printed and handwritten, a Hungarian stamp and a postmark from Pécs dated 1971.
